name: chengzhu
description: 成竹 Foresketch — 投研信息整理与仿真推演多 Agent 系统

scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd frontend && pnpm install
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:all: pnpm run setup && pnpm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others -n "backend,frontend" -c "green,cyan" "pnpm run backend" "pnpm run frontend"
